records.public_safe_text: on tuesday, november 18th, 2025, i, officer r. pizzo #4904 working as [identifier], and driving marked police unit #218-0591, was dispatched to a major accident call located at [roadway],, fort worth, texas, 76040, at 1807 hours. officer j. keith #4153, who was working as [identifier], and driving marked police unit #217-1029, was my assist unit. upon our arrival, we were met by the driver of unit 1, and the pedestrian involved, in the parking lot of the admiral apartment complex, located at [roadway]. the driver of unit 1 stated that he was traveling southbound at [roadway]., when he decelerated to an estimated 15mph, in order to make a left turn into his residence, which is the admiral apartment complex. due to the driver of unit 1's inattention, and the unlit crosswalk that the pedestrian was walking in, he was unable to see the pedestrian crossing. he then made a left turn, into his apartment complex, and subsequently struck the pedestrian with the front of his vehicle, as she was walking northbound. he immediately stopped his vehicle, in the parking lot, and checked on her condition. unit 1 sustained a shattered windshield, as a result of the collision, but no other damages. the pedestrian stated that she was walking northbound, through the entryway of the admiral apartment complex, when she was struck by the driver of unit 1. the pedestrian stated that her body broke unit 1's windshield as a result of the collision. the pedestrian refused medical attention on scene. no injuries were reported. the pedestrian and the driver of unit 1 exchanged information.

records.deidentified_narrative: this is a single vehicle collision resulting in a pedestrian fatality. america's auto auction employee pamela flores was attempting to move the vehicle out of the parking space in front of the america's auto auction main office building, 116611 ih-35, to transport it to covert chevrolet bastrop. when the vehicle would not operate in reverse, coworkers josefina and tiffany came to assist. while attempting to push the vehicle, the vehicle suddenly lurched forward, pinning josefina between the vehicle and the building, resulting in josefina's death. taylor nieves, security guard, was sitting at the desk directly on the other side of the wall/window where the impact occurred and was struck with glass. buda police officers and fire/ems personnel responded on scene. the justice of the peace also responded to the scene and declared time of death at 1949 hours. the vehicle was towed for evidence. buda police officers conducted an investigation. [case id]: open / active. see bpd 2025-15045 for investigation details.

records.deidentified_narrative: at the listed date and time, police responded to the listed location, a private parking lot, for an accident minor. i made location and ensured no one needed immediate medical attention. neither party requested ems. i spoke to u2, a pedestrian. u2 stated she was walking from her vehicle to the building for physical therapy. u2 stated unit 1 reversed into her and did not stop. u2 stated she did not fall down but was pushed by unit 2. u2 stated she was in pain but was also in pain from before the collision and was why she was coming to physical therapy. u2 stated unit 1 hit her hip and knee. u2 denied ems and stated she would tell her physical therapist about the incident. i spoke to the driver of unit 1 (u1). u1 stated he reversed from his parking spot and did not see anyone behind him. u1 stated he did not hear a ""thud"" or anyone yell as if they were about to get hit. u1 stated he did not believe he hit anything or anyone but stayed at the location because u2 told u1 that u1 had backed up into u2. u2 provided me with a valid drivers license and insurance. both u2 and u1 were provided case cards and informed of follow up procedures. dmea
